title: Black Light Time-Aware Physical FTL Route Path Registry

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Family-specific gravity sensitivity, route miscalculation, predictive safety and realistic mathematical underlays require gravitational source positions to carry epoch and uncertainty rather than remain frozen forever at a catalog snapshot.

integrationPolicy.currentRule: Propagate every supplied authoritative gravitational source from its source epoch to one declared route epoch before physical route sampling.
integrationPolicy.sourceRequirement: A source used for time-aware propagation requires position, velocity and source epoch. Missing velocity is unresolved motion, not zero motion.
integrationPolicy.covarianceRule: Propagated covariance and process-noise ancestry remain attached to the source-state packet. Missing covariance keeps the result PARTIAL rather than implying perfect certainty.
integrationPolicy.validityRule: OUTSIDE_MODEL_VALIDITY from source propagation blocks route sampling. It is not converted into a large finite route-severity score.
integrationPolicy.nextFidelity: Family-dependent encounter-time sampling t(s) remains PROPOSED until the route representation provides a defensible mapping from route fraction to encounter epoch.

physicalMathematics.safeguard: Source-state propagation changes the gravitational source geometry supplied to ordinary gravity calculations; it does not establish any fictional FTL family as physically real.

CONTINUOUS_PROJECTED_PROGRESS.equation: t(s)=t0+s*L/v_progress only when v_progress is a defined route/control representation for that family
CONTINUOUS_PROJECTED_PROGRESS.warning: v_progress is not a claim of local real-space superluminal motion.

PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT.rule: Use commitment and emergence epochs rather than fabricate a local progress speed.

canonSafeguards: This registry does not establish that any FTL method is physically realizable.
Propagated source states are derived engineering estimates at a target epoch, not new historical canon.
Named race, vessel, manufacturer and installation sources outrank this generic integration layer within their documented scope.
A simulation-selected family does not establish that a named civilization uses that family.
Missing source velocity, covariance, epoch, acceleration or model-validity evidence may not be silently replaced by zero.
A route-epoch snapshot is not equivalent to a fully time-resolved encounter model; the distinction must remain visible in provenance and user-facing documentation.
Fold, Q-Lattice and Phase Displacement may not be assigned a fabricated continuous superluminal progress velocity merely to simplify encounter-time mathematics.
